Kanpur School Bus Accident Kills Teacher, Injures 10

A school bus carrying students to school on Gandhi Jayanti collided with a dumper truck in Bidhnu, Kanpur. Science teacher Aishwarya Srivastava of Cheena Public School died in the accident. Ten other people, including five students and two teachers, were injured, with two teachers reported to be in serious condition.
